items.title: Help BIMCO Shape the Future of Biofouling Management
items.summary: BIMCO is seeking industry feedback on practical experience with the 2023 IMO Biofouling Guidelines as the IMO considers details of a mandatory Convention. The survey gathers insights on implementation, effectiveness and operational challenges and forms part of a wider BIMCO evidence-gathering initia
items.summary_zh: BIMCO 正在蒐集業界對 2023 年 IMO 生物附著管理指南實務經驗的回饋，作為 IMO 研議制定具強制力公約之依據。本次調查涵蓋執行現況、有效性及作業面挑戰，並屬於 BIMCO 整體證據蒐集工作的一部分。

items.title: Your input needed on new Virtual Notice of Readiness Clause for Voyage Charter Parties
items.summary:
We are developing a new Virtual Notice of Readiness and Just in Time Arrival Clause for Voyage Charter Parties aimed at supporting more efficient voyage execution while addressing some of the legal and commercial barriers to Just in Time (JIT) operations. 
We are looking to provide a contractual fra
items.summary_zh: 相關機構正研擬新的航次租船合約「虛擬備便通知 (Virtual NOR)」與「準時抵達 (JIT)」條款，旨在提升航次執行效率並解決 JIT 作業的法律與商業障礙。目前正徵詢業界對此合約框架之意見。

items.title: BIMCO seeks industry input on contractual gaps from Gulf disruption
items.summary: For months, ships and their crews have been facing extremely difficult and challenging circumstances in the Persian Gulf. Following the outbreak of hostilities in late February 2026 and the subsequent severe drop in traffic through the Strait of Hormuz, many ships already inside the Gulf have been u
items.summary_zh: 波斯灣衝突於 2026 年 2 月下旬爆發後，荷莫兹海峽通行量大幅下降，許多滯留於波斯灣內的船舶面臨嚴峻情況。為此 BIMCO 正就現行契約條款在戰爭風險與航行中斷情境下的適用性徵集業界意見，探討是否需要在標準合約中新增或修訂條款來因應此類區域性衝突所衍生的合約空隙。

items.title: HNS Convention set to enter into force in November 2027
items.summary: The international maritime regime for liability and compensation following incidents involving hazardous and noxious substances is set to change when the International Convention on Liability and Compensation for Damage in connection with the Carriage of Hazardous and Noxious Substances by Sea enter
items.summary_zh: 《1996 年國際海上運輸有害及有毒物質造成損害之責任與賠償公約》(HNS 公約) 預定於 2027 年 11 月生效。該公約規範危險及有毒物質 (HNS) 海上運輸造成損害時的責任與賠償制度,生效後將對裝載 HNS 貨物的船舶及營運人產生新的法律與保險義務。船東需提前檢視船舶是否裝載 HNS 貨物、準備相關文件,並評估對責任險與強制保險要求的影響。

items.title: Leadership Perspective: BIMCO Strategy 2026
items.summary: This article by BIMCO Secretary General and CEO David Loosley was originally sent to the CEOs of all BIMCO member companies and organisations on 29 July 2026.

items.title: New member benefit: weekly freight market assessments from Platts S&P Global Energy
items.summary: If you are a BIMCO member, you can now access weekly freight market assessments from Platts S&P Global Energy on our website.
items.summary_zh: BIMCO 會員現在可在其網站上取得 Platts S&P Global Energy 每週貨運市場評估資料。

items.title: Revised PRC Maritime Code: Key considerations for managing contractual risk
items.summary:
China occupies a pivotal position in global shipping and is home to many of the world’s busiest ports.  Consequently, a significant proportion of international trade involves cargo that is loaded, discharged or transhipped through Chinese ports. 
Against this backdrop, the revised Maritime Code of t
items.summary_zh: 中國《海商法》修訂對國際航運契約風險管理產生重要影響，涉及貨物裝卸、轉運及相關合約條款。修法內容與全球主要港口及貿易活動密切相關，業者需關注其對責任歸屬與爭議解決的潛在變化。

items.title: BIMCO launches surveys to support practical biofouling management
items.summary: As the International Maritime Organization considers the details of future mandatory measures to manage ships’ biofouling, industry input is essential to ensure any requirements are practical and effective. BIMCO has launched three surveys covering inspection, cleaning service in ports and shipowner
items.summary_zh: BIMCO 推出三項關於生物附著（biofouling）管理的問卷調查，涵蓋檢查、港口清洗服務及船東實務經驗，旨在蒐集業界意見，作為 IMO 制訂未來強制性生物附著管理措施時的參考依據。

items.title: AI-generated contracts and clauses: why the human element still matters
items.summary: Artificial intelligence is rapidly becoming part of everyday work in commercial shipping, including how contracts and clauses are drafted, reviewed and compared. From document review and clause comparison to drafting assistance, AI is already changing how contractual work is carried out across the s
items.summary_zh: AI正快速進入商業航運合約與條款的起草、審閱及比對流程。儘管AI可協助文件審閱、條款比較與起草,但人類專業判斷在合約工作中仍不可取代。對航運公司而言,AI工具可提升合約作業效率,但不應完全取代人為審核。

items.title: BIMCO welcomes proposal to include Indian ship recycling yards on EU list
items.summary: The EU Commission has launched a proposal to EU member states to add two Indian ship recycling facilities to its list of approved yards. If approved, this would mark the first time that Indian yards have been recognised under the EU Ship Recycling Regulation (EU SRR), representing a milestone for a
items.summary_zh: 歐盟委員會已向成員國提出提議，將兩個印度船舶回收設施納入其批准的船廠名單。如果獲得批准，這將是印度船廠首次根據歐盟船舶回收法規獲得認可，標誌著一個重要里程碑。

items.title: Navigating alternative fuels: new industry guidelines for methanol Safety Management Systems
items.summary: As methanol gains ground as a marine fuel, the Maritime Technologies Forum (MTF) has published new guidelines to help companies develop or adapt Safety Management Systems for methanol-fuelled ships. items.summary_zh: 隨著甲醇作為海洋燃料的普及，海事技術論壇（MTF）發布了新指導方針，幫助公司為甲醇燃料船舶開發或調整安全管理系統。這些指導方針是與BIMCO及其他主要利益相關者合作制定的。

items.title: Have you used electronic bills of lading? We want to hear from you!
items.summary:
If you are you one of the growing number of companies who have successfully adopted eBLs, might you be willing to share your experiences?
If so, BIMCO and the FIT Alliance want to showcase the lessons learned along the way.
To support this, we have launched a survey to collect real-world eBL experie
items.summary_zh: 如果您是越來越多成功採用電子提單的公司之一，是否願意分享您的經驗？BIMCO 和 FIT 聯盟希望展示這些經驗教訓，並已啟動調查以收集實際的電子提單經驗。

items.title: New BIMCO survey explores challenges and best practices in operational crewing and rest hour compliance
items.summary: As fatigue management, crewing and seafarers rest feature increasingly on the international regulatory agenda, BIMCO is asking the industry to share practical experience on challenges and best practices related to operational crewing and compliance with work and rest hour requirements. items.summary_zh: BIMCO 正在進行調查，徵求業界分享在操作人員配備及遵守工作與休息時間要求方面的挑戰與最佳實踐經驗。隨著疲勞管理和船員休息越來越受到國際法規的重視，這項調查旨在收集相關意見。

items.summary_zh: 隨著航運業尋求脫碳的可行途徑，生質燃料已成為一個可立即使用的過渡選項，通常可以在不需或少量修改現有引擎和燃料系統的情況下使用。

items.title: UK ETS: Expansion into the Maritime sector from 1 July 2026
items.summary: The United Kingdom has expanded the UK Emissions Trading Scheme (UK ETS) to the maritime sector from 1 July 2026. The initial maritime phase is expected to apply to domestic maritime activity, including voyages between UK ports and emissions generated while vessels are in UK ports, such as at berth
items.summary_zh: 英國已將英國排放交易計劃（UK ETS）擴展至海事部門，將於2026年7月1日生效。初步的海事階段預計將適用於國內海事活動，包括英國港口之間的航行及船舶在英國港口（如停泊時）產生的排放。
